title: Ask your AI to teach you the editor: an AI-focussed manual, and an agent that can highlight the UI (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Ideally there should be some way to ask your ai to teach you how to use it. This means that we need to have an ai focussed manual. 

Is there a way we could allow an agent to highlight a component in the ui?

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-29, while planning the third-party-ready essay editor; recorded verbatim (one message, split by thought).
